## Tokio for Minecraft

The Fabric mod that connects your Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 world to Tokio. Put the jar in your `mods` folder, with Fabric Loader and Fabric API.

## What's Changed

## New Features

- [ [`91afd01`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/91afd01a8a525b2940112c1ad3f91272b1a38dc4) ] - **Draw the lasers as beacon beams on the mod's clients** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`eef9d71`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/eef9d71da23cc1b705d3ce640a9d98b73cb73077) ] - **Add /tokio laser super and super duper** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`45cc4a6`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/45cc4a6279c6d5b43d3003c74a58bac2f80615b0) ] - **Add /tokio meteor and /tokio laser** _by_ Italo Alfaro

## Fixes

- [ [`856b31a`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/856b31a5bc434ac68067984bf4b81cc370b2ba10) ] - **Keep the super lasers' night from sticking** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`e0f7be2`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/e0f7be2511b4886d3b6f4a94b05785ba41a71142) ] - **Aim the meteors and lasers at the ground under the player** _by_ Italo Alfaro

## Other Changes

- [ [`0355631`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/035563113aa267f070f237b254cd9fae5a884c9f) ] - **Describe the super lasers and their beams** _by_ Italo Alfaro

- [ [`6f8b0ad`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/6f8b0add78c07f73e6ea369bcf057bdb7aee9125) ] - **Describe the meteor and the laser** _by_ Italo Alfaro
- [ [`36086ab`](https://github.com/tokio-app/minecraft-mod/commit/36086ab7e8d9d13f79f9120e42b8bd37723411c7) ] - **Check the meteor and the laser in game tests** _by_ Italo Alfaro
